name: golden_set_v1
purpose: Golden set for FretWise / GuitarDataSet phrase-window model validation. Each line encodes a short musical passage with the human-validated correct fingering, anchor, and (where applicable) barre group annotations. Models MUST NOT train on this file; use only at evaluation time.

field_specification.case_id: string — unique identifier, snake_case, references the spec category if applicable
field_specification.source_file: string — path relative to bulk data root, or 'synthetic/<name>' for crafted cases
field_specification.source_type: enum — gp | musicxml | midi | chord_library | manual | synthetic
field_specification.measure_range: [int, int] — inclusive measure bounds in the source file (1-based)
field_specification.style: enum — jazz | rock | blues | classical | folk | metal | pop | surf_rock | any | unknown
field_specification.tuning: [int, int, int, int, int, int] — open-string MIDI from string 1 (high E) to string 6 (low E). Standard = [64, 59, 55, 50, 45, 40].
field_specification.annotator: enum — manual_review | human | mutopia | uci_chords | jguitar | caged | fretwise_silver
field_specification.confidence: float in [0, 1] — annotator confidence; values <1.0 mean 'verify against partition before training v2 fine-tune'
field_specification.rationale: string — short prose explaining WHY this fingering is correct (musical / biomechanical reasoning)
field_specification.expected: list of expected notes — see expected_note_fields below. The MODEL_TARGET key.
field_specification.negative_alternatives: (optional) list of incorrect alternatives the model must avoid
field_specification.barres: (optional) list of barre group descriptors when the case includes a barre
field_specification.notes_on_anchor: (optional) string — additional context for anchor choice

expected_note_fields.finger: enum — open | index | middle | ring | pinky
expected_note_fields.anchor: (optional) int — fret of the position anchor; null for pure open chords
expected_note_fields.hand_position: (optional) int — fret of the virtual index; null when finger=open and no fretted note constrains the hand
expected_note_fields.is_chord_member: (optional) bool — true for simultaneous chord notes
expected_note_fields.techniques: (optional) list of strings — hammer_on, pull_off, slide, bend, vibrato, let_ring, staccato, palm_mute

negative_alternatives_field.reason: string — why this alternative is wrong
negative_alternatives_field.fingers: list of strings — the wrong finger sequence
negative_alternatives_field.anchor: (optional) int — wrong anchor that produces this sequence

barres_field.finger: enum — index | middle | ring | pinky (typically index)
barres_field.fret: int — fret across which the barre lies
barres_field.strings: list of ints — strings covered by the barre (1-based)

version_bump_required_when: adding a new case category not in `categories_covered`
expansion_policy.next_target_size: 50+ cases (v2 will add cases from genuine FretWise audits)
